sent_bad: When you apply, you must answer questions on a special form about why you quit or were fired, whether you tried to fix the problem, and whether your employer gave you warnings, after which "Service Canada may interview you. They may also contact your employer" (doc.txt).

If you were fired, benefits are denied only if Service Canada finds "misconduct," which "usually means doing something wrong on purpose," such as threatening someone, destroying company property on purpose, being away from work without permission, or not obeying an order, and "Service Canada decides if you were fired for misconduct, not your employer" (doc.txt).
